headers.//: Everything defaults to revalidate-first. Firebase Hosting otherwise serves index.html with max-age=3600, so a crew phone could keep running an hour-old bundle after a deploy: the service worker's network-first navigation still answers from the browser's HTTP cache. During a live move a hotfix has to land in seconds, not within the hour.

Build assets carry a content hash in the filename, so a changed file is a changed URL. These are safe to cache hard and forever, which is what keeps the app fast on a phone in a stairwell. Listed after the catch-all so it wins for this path.
